in_marathi.name: Dibyendu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge, Intelligence, Shining, Glowing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dibyendu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dibyendu is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Dibya’ meaning intelligence, knowledge and ‘Indu’ meaning drop or river. This name is given to a boy who is considered to be the embodiment of knowledge and intelligence, shining and glowing with wisdom. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Shiva, the God of knowledge and wisdom.
